Signed Per-Row Score Delta for an Evidence Diff

Source: R/evidence_delta.R
evidence_delta.Rd

Scores each row of an evidence_diff() result on a signed scale, so you can see not just that a finding moved but how much weight that movement carried. The score reuses the package's existing scoring primitives, result_to_score() and severity_to_weight(); it invents no new weights.

Usage

evidence_delta(diff)

Arguments

diff

A data.frame produced by evidence_diff() (it must carry the change, direction, result_from, result_to, severity_from, and severity_to columns).

Value

The input diff, unchanged in row order and contents, with one new numeric column delta appended: the signed per-row penalty movement described above. Any "summary" attribute on diff is preserved.

Details

Each state (the from side and the to side of a row) is reduced to a weighted penalty, (1 - result_to_score(result)) * severity_to_weight(severity). A passing check carries no penalty; a failing, high-severity check carries the most. A row's signed delta is penalty_from - penalty_to, so a positive delta means the weighted penalty fell (the submission got better at that row) and a negative delta means it rose. States that are absent (the missing side of an added or removed row) or na contribute no penalty, so an added finding shows a negative delta and a resolved finding a positive one.

Note that the delta is penalty-based: adding or dropping a passing check leaves the penalty load unchanged and so scores 0, even though evidence_diff() still labels it improved (more coverage) or regressed (lost coverage) in the direction column. The two views are complementary: direction is categorical and coverage-aware, the delta is a magnitude.

See also

evidence_diff() for the diff this consumes and evidence_diff_summary() for the tidy rollup built on top of it.

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(r4sub_run_context("STUDY1", "DEV"))
mk <- function(id, result, severity) {
  suppressMessages(as_evidence(
    data.frame(
      asset_type = "validation", asset_id = "ADSL",
      source_name = "pinnacle21", indicator_id = id,
      indicator_name = id, indicator_domain = "quality",
      severity = severity, result = result,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    ctx = ctx
  ))
}
old <- suppressMessages(bind_evidence(mk("A", "fail", "high"), mk("B", "pass", "low")))
new <- suppressMessages(bind_evidence(mk("A", "pass", "high"), mk("C", "fail", "medium")))
d <- evidence_diff(old, new)
evidence_delta(d)[, c("indicator_id", "change", "direction", "delta")]
#>   indicator_id  change direction delta
#> 1            A changed  improved  0.75
#> 2            C   added regressed -0.50
#> 3            B removed regressed  0.00
